# API routes

> Every route DjangoERP serves — method, path, view or viewset action, the DRF permission classes it enforces, and its summary — read from Django's URL resolver.

Paths are relative to the host (`http://localhost:8000` in development). Every `/api/` route needs a JWT bearer token from `POST /api/auth/login/` unless its **Access** column says `public`. DRF's `DefaultRouter` also serves each route with a format suffix (for example `.json`); those copies are not listed. Collection routes take the filters, search and ordering their viewset declares — see the viewset in each app's `views.py`.

| ANY | `/admin/` | Django admin | staff session | The Django admin site. |
